name: storehand
description: Open-source skills that turn Claude into your daily Shopify operator. Today: store setup, a daily briefing (orders, payment problems, cancellations, stock alerts), a weekly health check (sold-out products, broken links, discount and metadata gaps) and a listing writer that proposes product copy into a file you edit before anything is written. On the way: price watching, SEO audits and weekly reports. Runs through the official Shopify CLI. Read-only by default. Sends no telemetry.
